description: Every few days, rank 43 Binance coins by their recent return and hold the strongest, long-only on spot or long the strongest and short the weakest on futures. The universe includes coins that later collapsed or were delisted (FTT, LUNA, SRM, MATIC, FTM, EOS), so a dead coin that was held counts.
name: Coin rotation (cross-sectional momentum)
selection: Selected: Sharpe of at least 1 and at least 15% a year before 2024-07-01. Survived: Sharpe of at least 0.5 and a profit from then on.
